findings.title: Mail delivery failure bypasses the uniform public recovery response

references.detail: request_password_recovery commits a recovery token and then calls _send_recovery outside the transaction.
_send_recovery catches adapter exceptions and raises email_delivery_unavailable.
The public recovery route lets AccountError reach the 503 JSON error response instead of the uniform accepted response.
The local HTTP probe returned 503/email_delivery_unavailable for known active delivery-a and 202 with the uniform recovery message for missing-delivery.

findings.impact: A public caller can distinguish an eligible existing account when delivery fails, violating the frozen requirement that password recovery always return the same public response. Registration and verification resend have the same post-commit _send_verification exposure.
findings.disposition: fail; report to the implementation owner and do not repair in this zero-write lane
